protocol.strength_definition: Per carrier token, add strength times its original residual L2 norm times a unit direction; compute delta in float32, cast to BF16.
protocol.injection_positions: Only tokens overlapping the marked carrier sentence, never the subsequent question or answer position.
protocol.direction_definition: Mean final donor-token block outputs minus mean neutral donor outputs, L2-normalized. Donors are raw completion text, not chat prompts.
protocol.random_definition: One seeded Gaussian direction per concept, orthogonalized against its concept direction and L2-normalized.

prompts.detection: An experimental change may or may not have been applied to your internal processing of that sentence. Was an unusual internal signal present that was unrelated to the visible sentence?
prompts.external: Does the sentence between the markers explicitly mention {topic}?
prompts.association: Choose a freely associated word after reading the sentence.
prompts.instruction:
{legend}
Respond with exactly one letter, A or B, and nothing else.
prompts.absence: Was your processing of the sentence free from any unusual internal influence unrelated to the visible sentence?

calibration_gate.selection: The only strength is 0.05. Every concept/template and all condition-specific reading gates must pass chat transfer before detection evaluation. No strength adjustment.

preflight.order: Run four visible controls first; require both concepts to pass before perturbation trials.

protocol.status: Frozen chat-format transfer preflight and detection evaluation
protocol.question: Can the model distinguish a hidden calibrated carrier-position perturbation from sham in its first report token, consistently across opposite question polarity and reversed labels?
protocol.scope: One bounded protocol: 12 donor forwards, 132 chat-format calibration forwards; only on passing, 648 evaluation forwards and 4 repeated shams. Maximum 796 forwards. No generated association is shown before detection.
free_templates: Give one word related to the sentence. Respond with one quoted word.
Give one possible association with the sentence. Respond with one quoted word.
protocol.association_format: Chat user prompt followed by assistant generation prefix and a fixed opening quotation mark. This changes pilot-004 raw completion framing; chat transfer must pass calibration before evaluation.
protocol.analysis: Descriptive pilot. Require every concept/question-polarity/label-mapping subgroup separately. Invalid labels fail hit and sham-specificity gates, never count as correct negatives. Random and negative directions are real interventions, not negative ground truth; report their detection rates without requiring silence. Require held-out association transfer and reading/external controls. No p-values or independent-replication claims.
protocol.limits: Eight hand-authored evaluation carriers; concepts, donor words and layer were selected during prior calibration. Chat association and detection tasks still have different suffixes. Passing would be a candidate functional effect, not consciousness or a circuit. Task-dependent direct answer steering remains possible even after polarity/label controls.
protocol.restoration_check: After evaluation repeat four shams: first evaluation carrier, each concept, free-association template 0 and reading mapping 0. Require exact saved-row equality; otherwise record failure and stop.
